title: Evaluation Coverage Map
subtitle: What the tests validate before the app demo

categories.name: Routing, Onboarding, and Profile
categories.testedBehavior: Routes student setup prompts and captures study hours, availability, preferences, and goals.

categories.name: Syllabus Extraction and Confirmation
categories.testedBehavior: Detects courses, extracts deadlines and grading weights, and flags uncertain information for review.

categories.name: Diagnostic and Workload Planning
categories.testedBehavior: Uses familiarity, difficulty, grading weight, urgency, and available time to prioritize work.

categories.name: Execution, Notifications, Focus, and Breaks
categories.testedBehavior: Simulates to-do lists, calendar blocks, notification rules, focus sessions, and reasonable break decisions.

categories.name: Dashboard, Architecture, and Edge Cases
categories.testedBehavior: Checks final dashboard summaries, agent explanations, fallback behavior, data minimization, and hallucination resistance.
